description: This file defines the interface 'SupervisedStream' in Java, which manages and supervises an Akka stream source queue for streaming supervision. It includes static methods to create source queues with supervision capabilities, and methods for stream lifecycle management such as completion handling, shutdown, and abort operations.

classes.name: SupervisedStream
classes.description: Interface for supervising an Akka stream source, providing methods to create, monitor, shutdown, and abort the stream.

classes.name: SupervisedStream.WithQueue
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating the materialized source queue and its supervising stream, providing accessors for these components.

methods.name: sourceQueue
methods.description: Creates a source queue with a supervision kill switch and returns it wrapped with supervision details.

methods.name: whenComplete
methods.description: Registers a consumer to be called upon stream completion or failure.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the supervised stream gracefully.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the stream with a specified Throwable error.
